simulation_brief.horizon_notes: Near-term horizon should preserve possibilities ranging from no formal action to process initiation, with approval unlikely absent procedural steps.
simulation_brief.summary: A famous donor publicly announces that a city stadium district will be rezoned for mixed-use housing, but formal authority remains with planning institutions and elected officials. No application has been filed at T0, environmental review would take at least 90 days, the stadium tenant has lease-based notice rights, and housing advocates support mixed-use goals while objecting to process bypass. Core tension is influence versus formal power under timing and procedural constraints.
simulation_brief.time_anchor: T0 set near T-2 days relative to latest source item
uncertainty_notes: Exact city, jurisdictional rules, and actor identities are unspecified and treated as fictionalized.
No evidence that planning commission or council has scheduled a formal vote at T0.
Donor influence level is publicly salient but not shown to override legal process.
